download_hf_model: download a Hugging Face model snapshot to a local directory by repo_id
download_models: download Hugging Face models using the HuggingFaceModelDownloadMixin class
create_download_hf_model: create a download_hf_model call to fetch a model with force download and no progress bars
test_download_hf_model: test download_hf_model with a specific repo_id and optional revision parameter
refactor_download_models: refactor HuggingFaceModelDownloadMixin.download_models to pass revision parameter through
